GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began very awkwardly resulting in its rdr becoming unbalanced. Had difficulty obtaining clear running in the early part of the straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Tightened @ start. Not pushed early & raced behind Mid Field Two Wide (5L from lead). Back 1 length midrace & pushed to quicken 3 Wide @ 600m. Pushed along @ rear 3 Wide @ 500m & pressured Five Wide (7L from lead) on home turn. Struggled in straight. # Never a chance.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Jockey reported that he anticipated settling in a midfield position, however, after checking his mount when buffeted between runners at the start, the gelding settled towards the rear of the field. He stated that his mount travelled fairly in this position throughout the early and middle stages, however, failed to quicken or run on in the straight on the heavy track and may have raced flat. A post-race veterinary examination revealed no abnormalities.
